description: Fork a detached pippin sub-command as a background job. Returns {id, pid, status: "running"} immediately; poll via job_show or block via job_wait. Use this for slow work (memos summarize, actions extract) so the caller isn't blocked. The argv must be a command that has an MCP tool of its own; batch and job run cannot be nested.

argv.description: Argv for the pippin child process (e.g. ["memos", "summarize", "--all"]).

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

dryRun.description: Check the call and report what it would do, without doing it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

title: job_run: arguments
